title: Mimas lineage
description: One divine lineage (lineages/*.json): the Blessing a player starts with and the pool the draft draws from. Design: #lineage. The loader also checks that the pool holds all three kinds and covers every item.

name.description: Display name; defaults to the id.

description.description: One line of flavour: 'Pray to Agni, Vayu and Indra.'

startingBlessing.description: A boons/*.json id of kind blessing belonging to this lineage.

pool.description: Boon ids of this lineage the draft may offer. Must contain a blessing, an enchant and a sigil, and cover every item.
